const incoming = $input.first().json;
const body = incoming.body ?? incoming;
const now = new Date();
const randomSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase();

const screeningAnswers = Array.isArray(body.screening_answers)
  ? body.screening_answers
  : [];

const candidateMaterial = [
  body.resume_text ? `RESUME
${String(body.resume_text)}` : '',
  screeningAnswers.length ? `SCREENING ANSWERS
${JSON.stringify(screeningAnswers)}` : '',
  body.recruiter_notes ? `RECRUITER NOTES
${String(body.recruiter_notes)}` : '',
  body.conversation_notes ? `CONVERSATION NOTES
${String(body.conversation_notes)}` : ''
].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');

return [{
  json: {
    trace_id: incoming.trace_id || `TRC-${now.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '')}-${randomSuffix}`,
    idempotency_key: incoming.idempotency_key,
    execution_id: String($execution.id),
    timestamp: now.toISOString(),
    date: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    started_at_ms: now.getTime(),
    environment: body.environment || 'staging',
    deployment_phase: Number(body.deployment_phase ?? 2),
    prompt_version: body.prompt_version || 'screening-v1.0',
    rubric_version: body.rubric_version || 'scorecard-v1.0',
    source: body.source || 'linkedin_jobs',
    linkedin_application_id: body.linkedin_application_id || '',
    candidate_id: body.candidate_id || `CAND-${randomSuffix}`,
    candidate_name: body.candidate_name || 'Unnamed candidate',
    email: body.email || '',
    phone: body.phone || '',
    job_id: body.job_id || 'JOB-001',
    candidate_material: candidateMaterial,
    daily_budget_usd: Number(body.daily_budget_usd ?? 2),
    input_price_per_million: Number(body.input_price_per_million ?? 0.30),
    output_price_per_million: Number(body.output_price_per_million ?? 2.50),
    green_threshold: Number(body.green_threshold ?? 75),
    red_threshold: Number(body.red_threshold ?? 50),
    confidence_threshold: Number(body.confidence_threshold ?? 0.70),
    review_team_chat_id: body.review_team_chat_id || $env.REVIEW_TEAM_CHAT_ID || ''
  }
}];

parameters.content:
## Intake, Idempotency, and Resilience
The independent intake workflow returns an immediate HTTP 202 response, then dispatches asynchronous processing. A persistent idempotency record prevents duplicate evaluations and supports controlled retries after failures.

## Manager-Worker Orchestration and RAG
The orchestrator delegates eligibility, scorecard, RAG, and QA work to independent sub-workflows. The private knowledge base is not included in this repository and must be configured by each deployment.

## AI Evaluation Supervisor and HITL
Every candidate evaluation is audited by an independent supervisor. Rejected evaluations freeze autonomy and route the case to human review. Human approval is required whenever governance thresholds are not met.

## Auditability, Privacy, and Cost Controls
Every run receives a trace ID. The workflow masks PII before model calls, checks for prompt injection, enforces a daily budget, records model usage, and persists decision evidence for auditability.
